name: graph-first-gate
description: DeepSeek Harness flavour of the same hard gate the pi adapter enforces: source files may not be read before the code graph has been consulted. Mounted through the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall. v2 (2026-10-16) shares the engine changes: 10-minute session window, scoped unlocks (a query keeps its named files/packages readable for 30 minutes), bash reads are gated where the harness reports them, and the block cap is 30 instead of 3.
